risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative operating, liquidity, financing, and COVID-19 information, including revenue mix, customer and device counts, credit facilities, and processing-volume impacts. Risk tone is moderately positive, emphasizing recovery to pre-pandemic volumes, but uncertainty remains around pandemic effects, supply chain conditions, debt costs, and reliance on non-GAAP measures. Boilerplate disclaimers and some causal qualifiers modestly reduce disclosure precision.
